item.title: It'll feel more like spring in Houston the rest of this week, but winter temps are back next week
item.description: Warm, humid air will lead to spring-like warmth and foggy mornings, but a cold front arriving this weekend will bring a chill back to the air early next week.

item.title: No threat found at Dobie HS after reports of student seeing armed person, Pasadena ISD says
item.description: Pasadena ISD said the lockdown was implemented to ensure the safety of everyone on campus. Later, it was reported that no threats were identified, and law enforcement is conducting classroom sweeps to provide an extra layer of safety.

item.title: Governor Abbott meets in Harris County, speaks on school walkouts on first day of early voting
item.description: Governor Greg Abbott was in Cypress on Tuesday afternoon, rallying supporters on the first day of early voting.

item.title: Warner Bros reopens takeover talks with Paramount after receiving a waiver from Netflix
item.description: Warner Bros. will reopen takeover talks with Paramount Skydance after receiving a seven-day waiver to do so from its preferred bidder, Netflix.

item.title: City of Conroe finally agrees to provide water, sewer to Willis ISD schools after months of tension
item.description: The City of Conroe has finally reached an agreement with Willis ISD to provide water and sewer services to multiple schools.

item.title: Harris County Judge Natalia Cornelio takes stand to fight public reprimand
item.description: Judge Natalia Cornelio is fighting a public reprimand she received from a state commission, which found she exhibited bias in a high-profile death penalty case.

item.title: Cause of death revealed for Victoria Jones, daughter of actor Tommy Lee Jones
item.description: The Office of the Chief Medical Examiner in San Francisco revealed the cause of death of Victoria Jones, daughter of actor Tommy Lee Jones. She was found deceased in a San Francisco hotel on New Year's Day.

item.title: Missouri City sues state to withhold photos from 13 Investigates
item.description: The Missouri City Police Department is going to court to fight the state's ruling that they must release photos of the 2024 evidence room leak to 13 Investigates.

item.title: Shelter-in-place issued after large fire breaks out at Dayton recycling plant, officials say
item.description: No injuries were reported after a large fire broke out at a recycling plant in Dayton on Tuesday night, according to officials.

item.title: Houston city council to vote on extending contract for 'antiquated' records system
item.description: Houston City Council is set to vote Wednesday on extending its contract for a records management system Houston police once called "antiquated."
